patches_modified.name: Remove LIVE extras
patches_modified.description: Removes the files for LIVE co-hosting, joining a LIVE as a guest, matches, games and gift effects, so the app gets about 3 MB smaller. The catch: in LIVEs, battle scores and guest names can go missing, and joining someone's LIVE by voice or video, co-hosting, games or animated gifts may stop working.

patches_modified.name: Remove avatar rings
patches_modified.description: Takes the story and LIVE rings off profile pictures, so tapping a picture opens the profile instead of a story or LIVE. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Remove content credential and card scanner assets
patches_modified.description: Removes TikTok's payment card scanner and content credential files, saving about 11 MB of storage. Anything in TikTok that needs them may stop working. Only patching again without it brings them back.

patches_modified.name: Remove creation tools
patches_modified.description: Removes TikTok's camera, editing and effects files, saving about 38 MB of storage. The catch: the Create tab and every recording, editing and effects tool stop working, and opening one, like effect search, can close TikTok. Leave it out if you make videos.

patches_modified.name: Remove unused language packs
patches_modified.description: Removes the app languages you don't list in this patch's options, saving up to about 26 MB of storage. English is always kept. With no list it keeps them all. Only patching again brings removed ones back.

patches_modified.name: Remove voice tools
patches_modified.description: Removes TikTok's speech recognition files, saving about 16 MB of storage. The catch: voice search, naming a song by listening, talking to TikTok's AI assistant and TikTok's music check on videos you post all stop working. Only patching again without it brings them back.

patches_modified.name: Repost diagnostics
patches_modified.description: With diagnostic logging on, notes when you repost a video and what TikTok answered, to help track down reposts that don't stick. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Resource and battery governor
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok reading your phone's motion sensors, which it can use to identify your phone, and stops a background speed test that can use a lot of memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches_modified.description: When you scroll back to a video, it picks up where you left off instead of starting over. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Run beside the store app
patches_modified.description: Lets a renamed copy of TikTok, made with Morphe's Clone app patch, sign in while the regular TikTok stays installed. Pick it together with Clone app. Google and Facebook sign-in won't work in the copy, so use email or phone.

patches_modified.name: SIM spoof
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok see the SIM country and carrier you choose. It may not change your region, since TikTok also goes by your internet connection and account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes the tracking codes from TikTok links you share, so the link carries less about you. It can also swap tiktok.com for another site. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Settings
patches_modified.description: Adds the Hushfeed settings page to TikTok, at the top of Settings and privacy. Pressing and holding For You at the top of the feed opens it too. That's where you turn Hushfeed's features on and off. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Share sheet tools
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide people, apps and buttons you don't use from the share sheet, add apps you do use, and copy a video's link with one press on Share. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Show LIVE search
patches_modified.description: Adds TikTok's search button inside the LIVE section where TikTok supports it, so you can look for LIVEs. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Show author region
patches_modified.description: Shows the country a video was posted from next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Show commenter handle and region
patches_modified.description: Shows a commenter's @username in place of their display name and the country their account is set to after the comment's time. It can also give each commenter's name a color of its own. Each starts off. Turn them on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Show engagement rate
patches_modified.description: Shows how many people liked, commented on, shared or saved a video compared with how many watched it, next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Show exact counts
patches_modified.description: Shows likes, comments and other counts as full numbers, like 1,234,567 instead of 1.2M. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Show follow status
patches_modified.description: Shows on a profile whether that person follows you back, and marks accounts in your follow lists that don't. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App. Optional local counts and appearance controls apply to your own profile.

patches_modified.name: Show the progress bar
patches_modified.description: Shows the progress bar on videos where TikTok hides it, so you can see how long a video is and skip around. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback, where you can also show the time beside the bar or give it a bigger handle. Seek bars for video stories and sound previews are there too.

patches_modified.name: Show the progress bar thumbnail
patches_modified.description: Shows a small preview picture while you drag the progress bar, so you can find the part you want. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Skip content warnings
patches_modified.description: Plays videos without the warning screen you'd have to tap through first, and can hide the Check sources and Check your sources banners. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Skip first-launch setup
patches_modified.description: Skips TikTok's setup screens on a fresh install, like the interest picker and the swipe tutorial. Sign-in and age screens still show. Its switch is on once picked, since setup runs before you can reach settings. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip passkey sign-in
patches_modified.description: Lets you sign in another way, like your password or a code by email or text, when TikTok wants a passkey. Password managers won't hand a passkey to a patched app, so that step can't finish here. With the switch on, TikTok treats your phone as one without passkeys. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip the splash ad
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop the full-screen ad TikTok can show while it starts up. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip update checks
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop two background tasks TikTok uses to check for updates, one of them when your phone starts. Some in-app update prompts may stop. Play Store updates still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Stay on the video in full screen
patches_modified.description: When a video ends in TikTok's full screen view, it stays on that video instead of moving to the next one. Swiping still moves on. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Stop on-device AI profiling
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop TikTok's built-in AI engine from starting, so it doesn't get a copy of everything TikTok logs about your use. TikTok works as if the engine weren't there. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop recording watch history
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok adding the videos you watch to your Watch history. The catch: your views stop counting, and For You learns less about what you like. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop saving search history
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok saving your new searches on your phone. Older searches stay until you delete them, and TikTok's servers may keep their own record. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop search autoplay
patches_modified.description: Stops videos in search results from playing by themselves. Each one shows its cover until you open it, so searching stays quiet. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Stop video looping
patches_modified.description: Stops a video at its end instead of playing it again. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Story controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a story replay when it ends instead of moving on, and keeps a photo story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Subtitle tools
patches_modified.description: Lets you make captions bigger, change their background and keep them in clear display, bring back TikTok's captions switch where it's missing, and save subtitle files with downloaded videos. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, and Downloads for subtitle files.

patches_modified.name: Swipe-left controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a left swipe on a video open its comments or do nothing, instead of opening the creator's profile. Starts off. Pick an action in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Translate comments
patches_modified.description: Translates comments as they load, using TikTok's own translator, so you don't have to tap Translate on each one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments, where more rows list languages TikTok's automatic translation should leave alone, keep videos in the language they were made in, pick the language translations come out in, and add TikTok's translate button beside the comment count.

patches_modified.name: Trust user certificates
patches_modified.description: Lets TikTok trust security certificates you install yourself, so a tool like mitmproxy can show what the app sends. The risk: anyone who gets a certificate onto your phone can read TikTok's traffic too. Use it only on a test phone.

patches_modified.name: Turn off haptics
patches_modified.description: Stops the little vibrations TikTok makes when you tap or hold things. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches_modified.description: Opens and closes TikTok's screens without the sliding animation, so moving around feels quicker. Swipes still follow your finger. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Use non-personalized search
patches_modified.description: Shows search results that aren't tailored to your account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Use system font
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's text in your phone's own font or in a .ttf or .otf font file you import, instead of TikTok's, and can use your phone's emoji too. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches_added.name: GmsCore support
patches_added.description: Lets Google sign-in and push notifications go through microG-RE instead of Google Play services. Pick it only if microG-RE is on your phone. Without microG-RE, Google sign-in and push notifications stop working in the patched app. It brings Spoof signature for Google sign-in along. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Newest reels first
patches_added.description: Plays the newest posted of the reels Facebook has loaded for you first in the Reels tab, instead of Facebook's own pick. It can't fetch newer reels. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_added.name: Pinch to zoom
patches_added.description: Pinch a story or a photo on someone's profile to zoom in, like you can on photos in the feed. It goes back when you let go, unless you turn on Stay zoomed under it, which keeps the zoom until you tap or press Back. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Comment sheet options
patches_modified.description: Small fixes for comments. Stop a long press on Like from opening reactions, hide the GIF and sticker buttons, show every reply without tapping View replies, load a whole reply thread as you scroll, open more replies with a tap anywhere on their row, hide Related groups under group posts, hide comments with shop links or your words, hide who is typing and the new comments pop-up, and hide the comment box under full-screen videos. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Comments.
patches_modified.previous_description: Small fixes for comments. Stop a long press on Like from opening reactions, hide the GIF and sticker buttons, show every reply without tapping View replies, load a whole reply thread as you scroll, hide Related groups under group posts, hide comments with shop links or your words, hide who is typing and the new comments pop-up, and hide the comment box under full-screen videos. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED black theme
patches_modified.description: Makes Facebook's dark mode black, or a dark color you pick, instead of dark gray, which can save battery on OLED screens. Cards and menus stay a shade lighter than the page. Turn on Black cards in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance to make them black too, and Lines between posts there for a thin gray line between posts in the feed. Light background color there gives light mode a soft color in place of white. Turn on dark mode in Facebook first. It isn't selected by default because undoing it means patching again. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it.
patches_modified.previous_description: Makes Facebook's dark mode black, or a dark color you pick, instead of dark gray, which can save battery on OLED screens. Cards and menus stay a shade lighter than the page. Turn on Black cards in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance to make them black too, and Lines between posts there for a thin gray line between posts in the feed. Turn on dark mode in Facebook first. It isn't selected by default because undoing it means patching again. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides clutter on reels, such as the Follow button, comment previews, Remix and Use template buttons and Threads cards between reels, so more of the video shows, and can play each reel once instead of over and over, keep its original audio instead of a Meta AI dub, drop the search suggestions under the caption, over the comments and at the top of a profile's reels, or hide the like, comment and share counts, the Save button, the speaker button or the line naming the reel's sound. It can also open a video you tap in the feed on its own, with no reels after it, and stop the "This is taking a while" message when a video is slow to load. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides clutter on reels, such as the Follow button, comment previews, Remix and Use template buttons and Threads cards between reels, so more of the video shows, and can play each reel once instead of over and over, keep its original audio instead of a Meta AI dub, drop the search suggestions under the caption, over the comments and at the top of a profile's reels, or hide the like, comment and share counts, the Save button, the speaker button or the line naming the reel's sound. It can also open a video you tap in the feed on its own, with no reels after it. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Always show publish date
patches_modified.description: Always shows the publish date in video author information. Thanks to lyyako for the original implementation.

patches_modified.name: Collection picker search
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show a search bar on the sheet where you pick the collection for a saved video, so you do not have to scroll through every collection.

patches_modified.name: Collection videos search
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show a search bar inside a collection that filters loaded videos by description or creator.

patches_modified.name: Comment sort controls
patches_modified.description: Exposes TikTok's native full comment-sort sheet, including its hot, time, media, and creator modes, instead of relying on rollout gates.

patches_modified.name: Copy comments without username
patches_modified.description: Copies only the comment text without including the creator's username.

patches_modified.name: Custom offline videos limit
patches_modified.description: Adds a custom entry to TikTok's offline videos menu with a configurable limit from 1 to 1000 videos.

patches_modified.name: Diagnostic tools
patches_modified.description: Adds diagnostic logging, crash capture, reports, and an optional rolling feed debugger.

patches_modified.name: Disable login requirement
patches_modified.description: Removes TikTok's mandatory login gate from supported flows.

patches_modified.name: Disable long-press quick share
patches_modified.description: Keeps long-pressing Share from opening TikTok's quick-share interaction.

patches_modified.name: Disable long-press repost
patches_modified.description: Keeps holding Like from opening TikTok's repost action.

patches_modified.name: Disable screen capture detection
patches_modified.description: Disables capture detection and secure-window screenshot protection, including Circle to Search blocking.

patches_modified.name: Downloads
patches_modified.description: Adds watermark-free downloads, video quality selection, comment sticker saving, configurable folders, and filename templates.

patches_modified.name: Enable Live search
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's search entry in the Live drawer where supported.

patches_modified.name: Enable non-personalized search
patches_modified.description: Uses TikTok's non-personalized search mode instead of its saved account choice.

patches_modified.name: Enable voice comments
patches_modified.description: Enables TikTok's native voice-comment recording and publishing entry points.

patches_modified.name: Favorite playlists grid
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show favorite playlists in a 3-column 8pt grid with square covers and the title and video count below.

patches_modified.name: Favorite playlists search
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show a search bar on the favorite playlists page that filters loaded playlists by name.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Lab
patches_modified.description: Adds a menu for viewing and overriding supported TikTok feature flags and configuration values.

patches_modified.name: Feed filter
patches_modified.description: Hides feed ads, TikTok Shop items, livestreams, stories, photo posts, and videos outside configured view or like ranges.

patches_modified.name: Feed tab navigation
patches_modified.description: Controls which loaded top and bottom navigation tabs remain visible, blocks newly added tabs when requested, and can hide the Tako AI bubble.

patches_modified.name: Fix Google login
patches_modified.description: Restores Google account sign-in after patching.

patches_modified.name: Foldable split comment view
patches_modified.description: Forces TikTok's tablet-style split layout (video beside comments instead of a bottom sheet) once the screen is at least as wide as a configurable threshold, for foldables TikTok doesn't already recognize as tablet-class.

patches_modified.name: Force show Auto scroll
patches_modified.description: Adds a setting that bypasses TikTok's rollout gates for its native Auto scroll action on supported videos.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI content
patches_modified.description: Hides posts marked as AI-generated or AI-modified by TikTok or their creators. Unmarked AI content may still appear.

patches_modified.name: Hide CAPTCHA popups
patches_modified.description: Adds a default-off setting to hide browsing and LIVE puzzle dialogs while preserving login and account verification.

patches_modified.name: Hide FYP unpersonalized slop videos
patches_modified.description: Hides certain batches of unpersonalized slop posts that appear in your For You feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed LIVE button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the LIVE button at the top left of video feeds.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed follow button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the + follow button below creator avatars in video feeds.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed save button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the save/favourites button from video feeds.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed search button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the search button at the top right of video feeds.

patches_modified.name: Hide floating promotions
patches_modified.description: Removes floating promotional badges, coin icons, and timer banners from the Home feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide quick comment reactions
patches_modified.description: Hides TikTok's exposed quick emoji row in supported comment inputs.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches_modified.description: Removes suggested-account cards from profile and inbox surfaces. Thanks to tymmesyde for the original implementation.

patches_modified.name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock
patches_modified.description: Enables TikTok's native hold, slide down, and release gesture to lock 2x speed.

patches_modified.name: Keep collections loaded
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to remember every collection you have loaded, so the collections page and the save sheet show them all right away instead of loading them page by page again.

patches_modified.name: Liked videos search
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show a search bar on the liked videos page that filters loaded videos by description or creator.

patches_modified.name: Open external links directly
patches_modified.description: Opens profile and story website links in the system browser instead of TikTok's in-app browser. Thanks to lyyako for the original implementation.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Enables playback-speed controls for all videos and remembers the selected speed between videos.

patches_modified.name: Region spoof
patches_modified.description: Adds in-app controls for changing the region TikTok reads.

patches_modified.name: Remember clear display
patches_modified.description: Remembers TikTok's clear-display state between videos.

patches_modified.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches_modified.description: Continues supported videos from where playback stopped when returning after a scroll.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking parameters from TikTok links before they are shared.

patches_modified.name: Settings
patches_modified.description: Adds the Crazy Erudite Patches settings menu to TikTok. Supports TikTok 47.4.3 and 47.2.41.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds the Crazy Erudite Patches settings menu to TikTok. Supports TikTok 47.2.41.

patches_modified.name: Share sheet modification
patches_modified.description: Adds toggles and allow-lists for the video share sheet's "Send to", "Share via app", and "Video Actions" sections.

patches_modified.name: Show seekbar
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's native video seekbar where it would normally be hidden.

patches_modified.name: Show seekbar thumbnail
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's video preview thumbnail while dragging the seekbar.

patches_modified.name: Sort collections
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to sort collections by recent activity (normal), by video count (most first) or by reverse video count (fewest first).

patches_modified.name: Stop video looping
patches_modified.description: Stops videos at the end instead of replaying them.

patches_modified.name: Translate comments
patches_modified.description: Adds comment translation controls using TikTok's translation system, with selectable language exclusions.

patches_added.name: Hide filtered posts
patches_added.description: Takes the posts Tumblr covers with "This post contains filtered content" out of your dashboard, searches and other feeds, so your filtered tags and words hide them completely. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_added.name: Hide suggested tags
patches_added.description: Takes the tags Tumblr suggests you follow out of your dashboard and other feeds, along with their headings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Dark background color
patches_modified.description: Makes the background of Tumblr's Dark Mode palette black, which can save battery on OLED screens, or another dark color you pick when patching. Other palettes stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Turns off Firebase crash reports and Google's analytics collection, and Tumblr's own tracking and ad measurement once it restarts. The Firebase and Google part stays until you patch again without it. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable update prompts
patches_modified.description: Stops Tumblr asking Google Play for a newer version and showing Play's update prompt. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Updates.

patches_modified.name: Filter activity notifications
patches_modified.description: Hides selected likes, reblogs, replies, follows, mentions, asks and boops from the activity list as pages load. Each switch starts off. Choose them in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Fix push notifications
patches_modified.description: Lets the patched app sign up for push notifications. Firebase can refuse a patched Tumblr whose request doesn't name Tumblr's original signature, so this sends its fingerprint. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Hide Blaze prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides the prompts to pay for Blaze, Tumblr's way to promote a post. That covers the Blaze buttons on your blog and dashboard, the nudge after you post, and the Blaze banners. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide Tumblr TV
patches_modified.description: Takes the Tumblr TV tab out of the bottom bar, and stops sign-up from sending you there. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide Watch it rows
patches_modified.description: Takes Tumblr TV's Watch it rows and video hub cards out of your dashboard and other feeds, along with their headings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Takes ad cards and paid Blaze posts out of your dashboard and other feeds, and stops Tumblr asking its ad networks for more. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Tumblr and the ad companies inside it see an empty advertising ID with ad tracking limited, as if you'd deleted your ad ID in Android. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide blog notification reminders
patches_modified.description: Hides the pop-up suggesting you turn on notifications for a blog. Your subscriptions and notification settings stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide gift purchase popups
patches_modified.description: Hides the pop-up suggesting you buy a gift for a blog. You can still open gifting yourself. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide hashtags
patches_modified.description: Takes the tags off the bottom of posts in your dashboard, other feeds and Tumblr TV, and keeps the source link. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide note counts
patches_modified.description: Takes the like, reblog and comment counts off the footer under posts, community posts included, and the counts off the top of a post's notes and its tabs. The buttons stay and still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide photo posts
patches_modified.description: Takes photo posts out of your dashboard and other feeds as each page loads. A post with pictures and no video, its reblog trail included, counts as a photo post. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide posts with these words
patches_modified.description: Hides posts matching your word list. Choose whether to check current text, the reblog trail, tags or summaries. Allowed words can keep a matching post, but other enabled filters still apply. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide reblogs
patches_modified.description: Takes reblogs out of your dashboard and other feeds as each page loads, and keeps the posts people made themselves. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested blogs
patches_modified.description: Takes the blogs Tumblr suggests you follow out of your dashboard and other feeds, whether as cards, rows or carousels, along with their headings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested communities
patches_modified.description: Takes the communities Tumblr suggests you join out of your dashboard and other feeds, along with their headings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide text posts
patches_modified.description: Takes text posts out of your dashboard and other feeds as each page loads. A post with no pictures or video, its reblog trail included, counts as a text post. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Communities tab
patches_modified.description: Takes the Communities tab out of the bottom bar and stops the Communities tips in the post editor. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Explore tab
patches_modified.description: Takes the Explore and search button off the bottom bar. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Follow button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Follow button out of the header of posts from blogs you don't follow yet. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Notifications tab
patches_modified.description: Takes the Notifications button off the bottom bar. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Save button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Save button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds, when Tumblr shows one. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide the ad-free banner
patches_modified.description: Hides the banner on your dashboard that asks you to pay for Ad-Free Browsing. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide the comment button
patches_modified.description: Takes the comment button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide the diamond and TumblrMart
patches_modified.description: Hides the Premium diamond and the TumblrMart button at the top of your dashboard, Explore and notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide the like button
patches_modified.description: Takes the like button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds, and the reactions off community posts. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide the reblog button
patches_modified.description: Takes the reblog button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide the share button
patches_modified.description: Takes the share button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide unread dots
patches_modified.description: Hides the unread dots and counts on the bottom bar's Dashboard, Communities and Notifications tabs, with a switch for each tab. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide video posts
patches_modified.description: Takes video posts out of your dashboard and other feeds as each page loads. A post with a video anywhere in it, its reblog trail included, counts as a video post. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: HushTumblr settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushTumblr page where you turn features on or off, pause HushTumblr, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it by long-pressing the Tumblr logo at the top of your dashboard, from Tumblr's Settings or by long-pressing the Tumblr icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Mute posts locally
patches_modified.description: Adds a local mute action to post menus. Originals and their reblogs stay hidden for this account. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Remove ad tracking permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes Google's advertising ID permission and Android's Privacy Sandbox ad services from Tumblr, so it can't use them. Google Play services then answers with zeros. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Reorder the bottom bar
patches_modified.description: Puts the bottom bar's tabs in an order you pick, from a list in its settings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Reveal allowed mature content
patches_modified.description: Removes mature-content covers only when Tumblr explicitly allows them for the signed-in adult account. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Show mutual markers
patches_modified.description: Marks blogs that follow your primary blog when you follow them. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Show post timestamps
patches_modified.description: Shows when posts were made using Tumblr's own timestamp layout. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Skip review prompts
patches_modified.description: Stops the pop-up that asks what you think of the Tumblr app and then asks you for a store rating or feedback. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Spoof signature for Google sign-in
patches_modified.description: Helps Google sign-in work in the patched app by naming Tumblr's original signature. It only helps with microG-RE or the XSpoofSignatures module. Email sign-in doesn't need it. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Turn off screenshot sharing
patches_modified.description: Stops Tumblr watching for screenshots, so taking one doesn't bring up its offer to save the post as an image. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Visible image descriptions

patches_modified.name: AMOLED black
patches_modified.description: Gives Telegram's Night and Dark themes pure black screens for a darker look. Message bubbles and menus keep their colors. On Android 13 and up the launch screen turns black too while your phone is in dark mode. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Add Repeat to the message menu
patches_modified.description: Adds Repeat, Copy photo, Message details and Quick forward to a message's press-and-hold menu, for resending, copying and forwarding faster. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Allow chat blur on slower phones
patches_modified.description: Lets slower phones show the blurred chat header and panels that Telegram keeps for fast phones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Ask before sending a sticker
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before a sticker, GIF, voice or video message, or call goes out, so a stray tap doesn't send it. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Black and white launch logo
patches_modified.description: With AMOLED black on and your phone in dark mode, the launch screen shows Telegram's logo in white on black instead of the blue one. It follows the switch on Android 13 and up. When Android reopens a Telegram it closed in the background, it shows the black screen in dark mode even with the switch off, since nothing can run that early. It isn't selected by default, since it has Morphe rebuild Telegram's resources. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it.

patches_modified.name: Change sticker size
patches_modified.description: Shows stickers in chats smaller or larger than Telegram does, at a size you pick. Animated emoji and dice keep their size. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Telegram from reporting how you use the app, like how long you read channel posts and what you tap on Premium screens, and keeps the camera from reporting your phone's maker and model. Messages, calls and notifications work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable call debug upload
patches_modified.description: Stops your phone from sending call problem reports and log files to Telegram when its server asks for them. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable chat swipe actions
patches_modified.description: Stops a sideways swipe on a chat from archiving, muting, pinning, deleting or marking it read, so a slip can't change a chat. Press and hold still has every action. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Disable double-tap reactions
patches_modified.description: Stops a double tap on a message from adding a reaction, handy if you keep reacting by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Disable draft link previews
patches_modified.description: Keeps Telegram from looking up a link's preview before you send the message. Sent messages still get a preview. The same page has Keep drafts on this phone, so unsent drafts stop syncing to your other devices, and Keep searches on this phone, so what you type in the main search isn't sent to Telegram. Each starts off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable pull to archive
patches_modified.description: Stops pulling down the chat list from opening the hidden archive. Open it from Archived chats in the chat list's menu instead. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Disable pull to next channel
patches_modified.description: Stops pulling up at the bottom of a channel from jumping to the next channel. A second switch does the same for forum topics. The channel switch starts on and the topic switch starts off. Find them in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Disable update checks
patches_modified.description: Stops Telegram from offering its own updates from telegram.org, which can't install over a patched app. Patch each new version in Morphe Manager instead. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Updates.

patches_modified.name: Exact numbers
patches_modified.description: Shows member, subscriber, view, reply and reaction counts in full, like 12,345 instead of 12.3K. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Faster downloads
patches_modified.description: Downloads files in 512 KB pieces, 8 at a time, the way Telegram already does for accounts its servers pick, instead of 128 KB pieces 4 at a time. If a big piece fails, Telegram still drops back to small ones. A second switch, Hold automatic downloads on Data Saver, keeps Telegram from downloading media on its own while Android's Data Saver is on and the network is metered. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Folders by chat type
patches_modified.description: Makes Private, Groups, Channels and Bots folders in one tap. They're Telegram's own folders, so they show as tabs above the chat list and on your other devices too. Turning it off removes the ones it made, unless you renamed or changed them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Gallery camera on tap
patches_modified.description: Keeps the attachment gallery from starting the camera or asking for camera access when it opens. The camera starts when you tap its tile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide Contacts tab
patches_modified.description: Removes the Contacts tab from the bar at the bottom of the main screen, and swiping doesn't open its page either. The Calls or Settings tab stays as Telegram has it, and the chat list's new message button still opens your contacts. A second switch, Compact bottom bar, makes that bar shorter and only as wide as its tabs need. A third, Side menu, brings back a menu that slides in when you swipe right on the chat list. All three start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide Premium, gifts and Stars
patches_modified.description: Removes Premium, Stars, My Grams, Wallet, Business and Send a Gift from Settings, Wallet and Send Gram from the chat, profile and link menus, Gifts tabs on profiles, the Gift button in channels, and Premium stickers, their effects and Premium emoji packs for an account without Premium, for a less cluttered app. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide Send as button
patches_modified.description: Hides your picture next to the message box in groups and channels where you could post as a channel, while you're posting as yourself. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide Stories
patches_modified.description: Removes the story bar above your chats, the rings around profile pictures and the Post Story button. Profile stories and archives stay. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide Telegram Features and Invite Friends
patches_modified.description: Removes the Telegram Features row from Settings and the Invite Friends rows from Contacts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored messages in channels, sponsored accounts in search and ads in Telegram's video player, so you see fewer ads. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide blocked users in groups

patches_modified.name: Hide gallery camera tile

patches_modified.name: Hide greeting stickers

patches_modified.name: Hide keyboard on scroll

patches_modified.name: Hide messages by keyword

patches_modified.name: Hide phone number

Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide popular apps

Find names in styled letters finds names written in decorative letters when you type plain ones.

patches_modified.name: Hide promotional banners
patches_modified.description: Hides Premium, birthday and low Stars balance banners above your chat list. Account security notices still show. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide recommendations
patches_modified.description: Hides suggested similar channels and bots, and stops Telegram from loading new suggestions. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide sender names when forwarding

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored proxy channel
patches_modified.description: Hides the sponsored channel a proxy adds to your chat list and folders. Your proxy settings aren't touched. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide time on stickers
patches_modified.description: Removes the time and read checks from stickers and big animated emoji in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide translate bar
patches_modified.description: Hides the translate bar at the top of chats in another language. Translate moves to the chat's menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Holiday look all year
patches_modified.description: Shows Telegram's Santa hat and New Year snow all year, not just around New Year. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel. patches_modified.name: HushTelegram icon and name

Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and name the app. Only patching again without it puts Telegram's icon back.

patches_modified.name: HushTelegram settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushTelegram row to Telegram's Settings, where you turn features on or off, pause HushTelegram, save your choices and export a report. You can also press and hold Telegram's app icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Ignore mentions in muted chats
patches_modified.description: Stops mentions and replies in groups or channels you've muted from notifying you. Chats you haven't muted notify as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Keep deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps a message on your phone when someone else deletes it, and marks it deleted next to the time. Your own deletes still work normally. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Keep videos muted on volume keys
patches_modified.description: Makes the volume keys only change the volume in a chat, instead of playing the video on screen with sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Message times with seconds
patches_modified.description: Shows seconds in each message's time, like 9:41:27 PM, so messages sent close together are easy to tell apart. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Open links externally
patches_modified.description: Opens ordinary web links in your browser instead of inside Telegram. Telegram links, sign-in and payment pages work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links. A second switch there, Keep your location from Mini Apps, starts off. With it on, Mini Apps and web pages opened in Telegram are told your location isn't available.

patches_modified.name: Play voice messages one at a time
patches_modified.description: Stops the next voice or video message from playing by itself when one ends. A second switch, Keep voice messages quiet while locked, stops voice and round video messages from starting while your phone is locked. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Quiet contacts nag
patches_modified.description: Once you've said no, stops the Contacts tab from asking for contacts access again and clears its warning badge. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Repair Firebase push registration
patches_modified.description: Tries to help a patched Telegram sign up for push notifications, by giving Google's Firebase service Telegram's original certificate. If Telegram's server still turns the sign-up down, as it does with your own API ID, it turns on Telegram's own Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection instead, unless you've set either one yourself. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Reveal spoilers
patches_modified.description: Shows spoiler text, photos and videos without the cover, so you don't have to tap. View-once media, sensitive content and login codes stay covered. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Save downloaded files
patches_modified.description: Copies each file and song you download to Download/Telegram on your phone, where file managers and other apps can open it, the way Save to Downloads does one at a time. Files from secret chats and from chats that don't allow saving stay in Telegram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Show user and chat IDs
patches_modified.description: Adds a copyable ID number for a user or chat to the profile menu. A second switch also shows where the profile photo is stored. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Silence people outside your contacts
patches_modified.description: Shows notifications from people who aren't in your contacts without sound or vibration. Bots, reminders and login codes keep their sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Start the camera on the rear lens
patches_modified.description: Opens the attachment menu's camera on the rear lens every time, not the lens you used last. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Strip link tracking
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking tags like utm_source, gclid and fbclid from links you open or share. Links with any other extra part stay unchanged. A second switch, No automatic sign-in on Telegram's sites, opens links to Telegram's own websites without the sign-in token Telegram adds for your account. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links.

patches_modified.name: Swipe back on profiles
patches_modified.description: Makes a swipe right on a profile's photos or media tabs go back, like the rest of the profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Translate with an outside service
patches_modified.description: Adds Translate here to a message's menu and Translate this chat to a chat's menu. Text you turn on goes to Google's web translate, or to an AI service with your own key if you set one, one message at a time, and nothing is sent before that. With an AI service, a How to translate box lets you say how you want it done. Telegram's own translation and its Premium checks stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Turn off haptic feedback
patches_modified.description: Stops Telegram from vibrating for taps, long presses, swipes and wrong entries. Calls and notifications still vibrate. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Turn off reaction effects
patches_modified.description: Stops the emoji burst and fly-in when someone reacts. The reaction still shows on the message. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: UnifiedPush notifications
patches_modified.description: Lets Telegram get its notifications through a UnifiedPush app like ntfy, for phones where Firebase notifications don't arrive. Telegram's servers wake it through the app, and the messages still come from Telegram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Use normal paste
patches_modified.description: Pastes text exactly as you copied it, without Telegram adding formatting, tables or code styling. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Use registered Maps API key
patches_modified.description: Lets maps in your patched Telegram use a Google Maps key you registered. Leave the option empty to keep Telegram's key. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and enter your key.

patches_modified.name: Use registered Telegram API credentials
patches_modified.description: Signs in to Telegram with the API ID and hash you registered at my.telegram.org. Fill in both options, or leave both empty to keep the originals. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Use Expert mode in Morphe Manager.

patches_modified.name: Use system font
patches_modified.description: Draws Telegram's bold, italic and code text in your phone's font instead of the one built into the app. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Voice messages in the music player
patches_modified.description: Makes tapping the bar above a chat, while a voice message plays, open Telegram's full music player with a seek bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED black
patches_modified.description: Gives Telegram's Night and Dark themes pure black screens for a darker look. Message bubbles and menus keep their colors. On Android 13 and up the launch screen turns black too while your phone is in dark mode. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Add Repeat to the message menu
patches_modified.description: Adds Repeat, Copy photo, Message details and Quick forward to a message's press-and-hold menu, for resending, copying and forwarding faster. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Allow chat blur on slower phones
patches_modified.description: Lets slower phones show the blurred chat header and panels that Telegram keeps for fast phones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Ask before sending a sticker
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before a sticker, GIF, voice or video message, or call goes out, so a stray tap doesn't send it. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Black and white launch logo
patches_modified.description: With AMOLED black on and your phone in dark mode, the launch screen shows Telegram's logo in white on black instead of the blue one. It follows the switch on Android 13 and up. When Android reopens a Telegram it closed in the background, it shows the black screen in dark mode even with the switch off, since nothing can run that early. It isn't selected by default, since it has Morphe rebuild Telegram's resources. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it.

patches_modified.name: Change sticker size
patches_modified.description: Shows stickers in chats smaller or larger than Telegram does, at a size you pick. Animated emoji and dice keep their size. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Telegram from reporting how you use the app, like how long you read channel posts and what you tap on Premium screens, and keeps the camera from reporting your phone's maker and model. Messages, calls and notifications work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable call debug upload
patches_modified.description: Stops your phone from sending call problem reports and log files to Telegram when its server asks for them. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable chat swipe actions
patches_modified.description: Stops a sideways swipe on a chat from archiving, muting, pinning, deleting or marking it read, so a slip can't change a chat. Press and hold still has every action. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Disable double-tap reactions
patches_modified.description: Stops a double tap on a message from adding a reaction, handy if you keep reacting by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Disable draft link previews
patches_modified.description: Keeps Telegram from looking up a link's preview before you send the message. Sent messages still get a preview. The same page has Keep drafts on this phone, so unsent drafts stop syncing to your other devices, and Keep searches on this phone, so what you type in the main search isn't sent to Telegram. Each starts off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable pull to archive
patches_modified.description: Stops pulling down the chat list from opening the hidden archive. Open it from Archived chats in the chat list's menu instead. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Disable pull to next channel
patches_modified.description: Stops pulling up at the bottom of a channel from jumping to the next channel. A second switch does the same for forum topics. The channel switch starts on and the topic switch starts off. Find them in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Disable update checks
patches_modified.description: Stops Telegram from offering its own updates from telegram.org, which can't install over a patched app. Patch each new version in Morphe Manager instead. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Updates.

patches_modified.name: Exact numbers
patches_modified.description: Shows member, subscriber, view, reply and reaction counts in full, like 12,345 instead of 12.3K. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Faster downloads
patches_modified.description: Downloads files in 512 KB pieces, 8 at a time, the way Telegram already does for accounts its servers pick, instead of 128 KB pieces 4 at a time. If a big piece fails, Telegram still drops back to small ones. A second switch, Hold automatic downloads on Data Saver, keeps Telegram from downloading media on its own while Android's Data Saver is on and the network is metered. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Folders by chat type
patches_modified.description: Makes Private, Groups, Channels and Bots folders in one tap. They're Telegram's own folders, so they show as tabs above the chat list and on your other devices too. Turning it off removes the ones it made, unless you renamed or changed them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Gallery camera on tap
patches_modified.description: Keeps the attachment gallery from starting the camera or asking for camera access when it opens. The camera starts when you tap its tile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide Contacts tab
patches_modified.description: Removes the Contacts tab from the bar at the bottom of the main screen, and swiping doesn't open its page either. The Calls or Settings tab stays as Telegram has it, and the chat list's new message button still opens your contacts. A second switch, Compact bottom bar, makes that bar shorter and only as wide as its tabs need. A third, Side menu, brings back a menu that slides in when you swipe right on the chat list. All three start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide Premium, gifts and Stars
patches_modified.description: Removes Premium, Stars, My Grams, Wallet, Business and Send a Gift from Settings, Wallet and Send Gram from the chat, profile and link menus, Gifts tabs on profiles, the Gift button in channels, and Premium stickers, their effects and Premium emoji packs for an account without Premium, for a less cluttered app. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide Send as button
patches_modified.description: Hides your picture next to the message box in groups and channels where you could post as a channel, while you're posting as yourself. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide Stories
patches_modified.description: Removes the story bar above your chats, the rings around profile pictures and the Post Story button. Profile stories and archives stay. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide Telegram Features and Invite Friends
patches_modified.description: Removes the Telegram Features row from Settings and the Invite Friends rows from Contacts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored messages in channels, sponsored accounts in search and ads in Telegram's video player, so you see fewer ads. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.
